Alan adındaki bütün kutuların birlikte s: The number of recipients all mailboxes in the domain can send to together per hour. Empty: default ({limit}); 0: unlimited. Last hour: {sent}.
Gönderim sınırı, 0 ile 1.000.000 arasınd: The sending limit must be a whole number between 0 and 1,000,000 (empty: default).
Kutunun saatte en fazla kaç alıcıya gönd: How many recipients the mailbox can send to per hour. Empty: server default ({limit}); 0: unlimited. Last hour: {sent}.
Saatlik gönderim sınırı: {limit}. Son bi: Hourly sending limit: {limit}. Sent in the last hour: {sent}. Your administrator can change the limit.
Ele geçirilmiş bir kutunun istenmeyen po: To limit spam from a compromised mailbox, the number of recipients each mailbox sends to per hour is counted. Once the limit is exceeded, new messages are temporarily rejected; it reopens on its own as the window slides. Mail sent from inside the server (sendmail, PHP mail()) is not covered by this limit.
Kutu başına saatlik alıcı sınırı: Recipient limit per mailbox per hour
Alan adı başına toplam sınır, ayrıca bel: The total limit per domain, unless set separately, is {factor} times this ({limit}). Enter 0 to remove the limit.
Şu an sınırsız. Kutu ya da alan adı için: Currently unlimited. A limit can still be set for a mailbox or domain.
Sınır, 0 ile 1.000.000 arasında bir tam: The limit must be a whole number between 0 and 1,000,000.
Bir kutu ya da alan adı saatlik sınırına: Mailboxes and domains that reach their hourly limit are listed here (at most one entry per hour).
Outlook, Thunderbird ya da telefon uygul: Set up the account in Outlook, Thunderbird or a phone app with these details.
Thunderbird, K-9 Mail, Outlook ve Apple: Thunderbird, K-9 Mail, Outlook and Apple Mail fetch the server settings from these addresses automatically when you type the email address. For this to work, the names below must point to this server in DNS (suggested in the DNS records section).
Otomatik ayar adresleri için nginx gerek: Automatic setup addresses need nginx; install it from the Components page first.

Outlook yalnızca HTTPS ile çalışır: auto: Outlook only works over HTTPS: the autodiscover name needs a valid certificate (for example the domain's wildcard certificate).
